contracts.commit_point: Acquisition gate at each entry's await try_acquire_automation(...) immediately before dispatch; the guarded effect commits at the awaited automation-run invocations performed under the held lease (heartbeat.py:583 base_model.text_query; telegram.py:356 text_query, telegram.py:441 audio_query, telegram.py:521 text_query; terminal.py:1538 base_model.text_query, terminal.py:603 runner(gorev)) and the run ends at the finally-block release_automation calls.
contracts.declared_mechanism: AutomationCoordinator lease protocol: try_acquire_automation atomically checks-and-sets state['busy'] under self._guard (asyncio.Lock) and returns (False, snapshot) when already held; each caller checks the boolean, rejects/skips with a busy message or recorded error on False, and calls release_automation in a finally block; release clears the lease only for the matching owner/job_id.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Concurrent automation on the shared BaseModel/browser session: entering a base_model.text_query / base_model.audio_query / submodel-runner automation run while AutomationCoordinator state busy is true, or running such automation without a successfully acquired lease (a False return from try_acquire must never be bypassed).

contracts.protected_resource: The shared BaseModel/browser automation session serialized by the module-singleton AutomationCoordinator lease (_automation_coordinator busy/owner/job_id/label/started_at/source state, guarded by an asyncio.Lock).
contracts.protection_obligation: Every automation caller that drives the shared BaseModel/browser automation session (heartbeat scheduled/manual jobs, Telegram text/voice/photo message handlers, terminal chat, terminal /agent test) must first obtain the AutomationCoordinator lease via try_acquire_automation and must release it afterwards; a caller arriving while the lease is held must be rejected, skipped, or answered with a busy message instead of proceeding into the shared session. Merges the duplicate first-phase and second-phase reviewer wording into one obligation.
scope_limits: The lease is in-process state (asyncio.Lock plus module singleton _automation_coordinator); it serializes automation only within one event loop/process and no cross-process or cross-host mutual exclusion is evidenced.
